meta.title: Backend API: Product entity + GET /api/products (phan trang) + GET /{id}

prompt.goal: Xay dung API doc san pham hoan chinh tu PostgreSQL: entity Product map dung bang products da co, GET /api/products ho tro phan trang (page, size, tra kem totalPages/totalElements), GET /api/products/{id} tra 404 khi khong tim thay.
prompt.context: - TASK-01 da xong: Spring Boot chay o port 8080, ket noi DB tot, bang products co du lieu. - Bang products: id (bigint, khoa chinh), name, price numeric, image_url, category, description. - Khong duoc sua cau truc bang (init.sql la nguon that).

scope.outOfScope: - KHONG lam POST/PUT/DELETE (CRUD ghi) - KHONG lam tim kiem/loc/category filter (task sau neu can) - KHONG lam security, validation phuc tap, cache

prompt.hardRules: - Gia tra ve API la number nguyen (VND), khong dinh dang string - Dung DTO, khong tra truc tiep Entity - Code theo lop: controller -> service -> repository
prompt.tasks: 1. Tao Product entity + ProductDTO 2. ProductRepository + ProductService (phan trang bang Pageable) 3. ProductController: 2 endpoint + xu ly 404 4. Global exception handler don gian (@RestControllerAdvice) 5. Tu test bang curl theo testPlan
prompt.constraints: - 60-90 phut. Khong doi port, khong sua DB
prompt.acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] GET /api/products tra dung 8 san pham (page=0&size=8), co totalElements = so dong trong DB - [ ] GET /api/products/1 tra dung 1 san pham - [ ] GET /api/products/9999 -> HTTP 404 + JSON loi - [ ] Backend khoi dong khong loi, log khong co exception
prompt.testPlan: 1. mvn spring-boot:run 2. curl "http://localhost:8080/api/products?page=0&size=8" -> kiem tra cau truc JSON 3. curl "http://localhost:8080/api/products/1" vs "/9999" (doi chieu AC) 4. curl page=1&size=4 -> content khac page=0 5. Doi chieu so lieu voi DBeaver: SELECT count(*) FROM products
prompt.outputRequired: - Danh sach file da tao/sua + mo ta tung endpoint - Pass/fail tung muc testPlan (kem curl da chay) - Rui ro (neu co)
